{
  "mutation_proposals": [
    {
      "target_block_id": "02",
      "target_block_family": "Service_Mapping",
      "mutation_type": "add_micro_rule",
      "priority": 1,
      "reason": "Improve grounding of receiver coverage and service coverage to fix semantic errors.",
      "edit_instruction": "Add a micro-rule to ensure all command-implied devices, owners, locations, and groups are preserved in the receiver expression.",
      "proposed_micro_rule": "Preserve command-implied device, owner, location, and group selector tags in the receiver expression to ensure full coverage."
    },
    {
      "target_block_id": "02",
      "target_block_family": "Enum_Grounding",
      "mutation_type": "add_micro_rule",
      "priority": 1,
      "reason": "Strengthen enum and numeric argument grounding to reduce enum_type_mismatch failures.",
      "edit_instruction": "Add a micro-rule to copy allowed enum values exactly and use unquoted numeric literals for numeric arguments.",
      "proposed_micro_rule": "For ENUM arguments, copy an allowed enum value exactly from the service descriptor; for numeric arguments, use unquoted numeric literals."
    },
    {
      "target_block_id": "06",
      "target_block_family": "Dataflow",
      "mutation_type": "add_micro_rule",
      "priority": 1,
      "reason": "Fix dataflow errors by ensuring sensor values are bound to variables before use in actions.",
      "edit_instruction": "Add a micro-rule to bind sensor readings to variables and use those variables in downstream actions.",
      "proposed_micro_rule": "When reading a value for reporting or control, bind it to a variable and use that variable in the downstream action."
    },
    {
      "target_block_id": "06",
      "target_block_family": "Temporal_Rule",
      "mutation_type": "add_micro_rule",
      "priority": 1,
      "reason": "Improve temporal grounding to fix temporal errors and numeric grounding issues.",
      "edit_instruction": "Add a micro-rule to represent elapsed time with explicit state variables and comparisons, converting units exactly per service descriptor.",
      "proposed_micro_rule": "For delayed or duration-based commands, represent elapsed time with explicit state variables and comparisons; convert elapsed time and units exactly according to the service descriptor."
    },
    {
      "target_block_id": "06",
      "target_block_family": "DET_Helper",
      "mutation_type": "add_micro_rule",
      "priority": 3,
      "reason": "Add targeted repair hints to fix semantic errors related to receiver coverage, service coverage, dataflow, numeric, and enum grounding.",
      "edit_instruction": "Add a micro-rule to guide repair of receiver coverage, service coverage, dataflow, numeric, and enum grounding when code is schema-valid but not target-equivalent.",
      "proposed_micro_rule": "If code is schema-valid but not target-equivalent, repair receiver coverage, service coverage, dataflow, numeric, and enum grounding."
    }
  ]
}

mutation_proposals.reason: Fix dataflow errors by ensuring sensor values are bound to variables before use in actions.

mutation_proposals.proposed_micro_rule: For delayed or duration-based commands, represent elapsed time with explicit state variables and comparisons; convert elapsed time and units exactly according to the service descriptor.
